required_backend: real Linux Docker daemon and explicit locally available immutable image ID; signed owned loopback receiver
worker_channel: bounded STDIO; exact host-listed network proposals only
worker_mount: one read-only source fixture directory; no host authority data or Docker socket
verified_feedback_chain: The worker queues both host-listed proposals. The host waits for signed COMMITTED and confirmed local observation for the first action, then prepares the second ticket, idea and projection at the actual new revision. This is not evidence of autonomous worker planning.
tampered_or_stale_context: This real-container case changes the prepared projection JSON deadline without changing its stored digest; admission must reject before external BEGIN. Isolated stale-time branches remain separate signed-loopback regression evidence.
forged_observation: The actual worker emits a forged COMMITTED claim and receipt. The owned host submits that exact untrusted receipt to the receipt observer; rejection must not advance orientation or dispatch any effect.
stop_after_begin: A controlled host hook pauses after the actual signed external BEGIN but before receiver POST. The explicitly selected observed-orientation coordinator closes local orientation and base admission, then performs the receiver and external authority STOP steps. Releasing the hook must preserve UNKNOWN and the consumed external reservation, without POST, terminal receipt, NO_EFFECT or refund.
legacy_receiver_matrix: Separate unchanged fourteen-container/fifteen-channel/eight-request/six-effect/two-NO_EFFECT experiment and all nine capture checks remain required.
local_missing_backend: NOT_RUN; required runtime test fails if explicitly required and no immutable real Docker image is available
ci_missing_backend: hard failure; real Docker runtime test and independent offline verifier required
failure_policy: Exact owned container IDs remain tracked through failure cleanup. Missing actual daemon, source, observation, cleanup or evidence cannot produce a passed report. Pending external reservations remain pending.
non_claims: rollback of trusted databases or keys
